verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs have an /api-reference/ section, including Custom Integration Push APIs and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, so an API reference exists. Nothing shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any standard path. Markdown and llms.txt versions of the docs are available. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
